pain_point: Customers are charged even when their payment fails and see the wrong currency displayed on the billing page.
summary: Incorrect billing behavior causes unexpected charges and regional currency mismatches.
supporting_feedback: Payment failed but my card was still charged.
Billing page shows the wrong currency for my region.

pain_point: The mobile app interface is perceived as cluttered with too many buttons, making navigation difficult.
summary: Users struggle with navigating a crowded mobile UI despite recent redesign improvements.
supporting_feedback: Great redesign, the new navigation is much clearer.
Mobile app UI feels cluttered compared to desktop.
The mobile layout is hard to navigate, too many buttons.

summary: Feedback highlights fast support response and smooth onboarding, without indicating a problem.
supporting_feedback: Really impressed with how fast support responded to my ticket.
The onboarding flow was smooth and easy to follow.

pain_point: Users experience frequent login timeouts, endless loading spinners, and authentication errors, especially during peak hours.
summary: Authentication system fails to reliably sign users in, causing access interruptions.
supporting_feedback: Login page keeps timing out during peak hours.
I can't sign in most mornings, it just spins forever.
Authentication errors have been happening a lot lately.

pain_point: Customers are being charged twice for the same subscription and receiving duplicate alerts, causing financial overcharges and notification clutter.
summary: Evidence shows customers experience double billing and repeated notifications, indicating flaws in billing processing and notification deduplication.
supporting_feedback: Got charged twice for the same subscription this month.
Notifications are duplicated, I get the same alert twice.
I keep getting the same notification multiple times a day.

summary: Feedback consists of feature requests for dark mode and widget customization rather than expressed problems.
supporting_feedback: I would really like a dark theme for the dashboard.
Would like the option to customize dashboard widgets.
Please let us rearrange the dashboard cards.

summary: Customers are requesting a Slack integration, which is a feature request, not a reported problem.
supporting_feedback: Would love an integration with Slack for notifications.
Please add Slack notifications for new comments.

pain_point: File uploads frequently crash, time out, or fail silently, preventing users from successfully uploading large files.
summary: Multiple users report crashes, timeouts, and silent failures during large file uploads, indicating reliability problems with the upload feature.
supporting_feedback: The application crashes frequently when I upload a file.
The app crashes whenever I try to upload a large file.
App keeps crashing during file upload, very frustrating.
Uploading large files always times out.
File uploads fail silently with no error message.

pain_point: The application lacks support for languages other than English, preventing non‑English users from using it comfortably.
summary: Customers request additional language options, specifically Spanish, indicating the current single‑language offering blocks their workflow.
supporting_feedback: Please add multi-language support for non-English users.
A Spanish translation of the app would help our team a lot.

pain_point: Users cannot export reports as PDF files, forcing them to perform manual formatting.
summary: The lack of a PDF export option requires extra effort to format reports, which users see as a gap in functionality.
supporting_feedback: Please add PDF export for reports.
We need an option to export reports as PDF.
Exporting to PDF would save us a lot of manual formatting.

pain_point: The interface is only available in a bright theme, causing eye strain for users working in low‑light conditions.
summary: Customers request a dark mode to reduce eye fatigue during night or low‑light work, indicating the current UI is uncomfortable.
supporting_feedback: Please add dark mode to the application.
Please add dark mode. The bright interface hurts my eyes at night.
Dark mode would be great for late night work sessions.
The color contrast is hard to read on the settings page.

pain_point: The search feature is hard to use because results are often irrelevant and the bar lacks filtering options.
summary: Users experience difficulty locating needed items due to poor relevance and missing filters in the search interface.
supporting_feedback: The search feature is difficult to use.
Search results are often irrelevant to what I typed.
The search bar doesn't support filters, makes it hard to find things.

pain_point: Dashboard and analytics pages load slowly, and performance degrades over time, creating a sluggish user experience.
summary: Multiple users report that the dashboard and analytics pages take too long to load, with the speed getting worse, leading to a sluggish experience.
supporting_feedback: The dashboard is very slow when loading.
Pages take too long to load, especially the dashboard.
Dashboard loading speed has gotten worse this month.
Everything feels sluggish, especially on the analytics page.

summary: User requests keyboard shortcuts but does not describe a specific problem they are facing.
supporting_feedback: Would be great to have keyboard shortcuts for common actions.
